selection: Retrospective: two complete donor cycles, selected after the recorded execution.
contrast: For each metric: adaptive change from its own baseline minus control change from its own baseline.
summary_unit: Runner pair; repeated windows within a pair are dependent.
scope: Saved-data descriptive analysis only. No new workloads, fitted warning rule, scientific pass threshold, inferred timestamps, outcome-based filtering or pooling.
path_length: Sum of successive full ILR displacement lengths at the recorded epoch frequency.
